## 4.3.0 (HexGhoul): the mastered Ukaku laughs the wings out; the Steel Blade drags at rest; the half mask is back

HexKagune 4.3.0 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol 132 (was 131): update the server and every player together.

You said (quoted exactly): "Ukaku Mastered animation should be a evil laugh sequence: Put hand on face (head tilted down), start laughing,
hand back down a little on the side (right hand) the hand should be a little to the right off the body, crack finger with sound, ukaku
emerges."; then "its a bit too much jitter, that laugh is horrible man", "can you revert it but add like "HAHAHAHAHA" text over the head
(similar the angry symbol above the head on npcs)", "no, white and with a cool letter type, not that shit".

**An Ukaku at full mastery (1000) brings the kagune out laughing** (before, Ayato's lift): the right hand comes up over the face as the
head bows, and the body holds still while the laugh rises over the head, "HA" by "HA" up to HAHAHAHAHA, in white manga lettering with a
thick black outline, each HA tilted its own way and popping in, with a low cackle; then the hand comes down a little, out to the right of the
body, the fingers crack, and the wings tear out with blood and a heavy beat. Every sound is Minecraft's own.

**The Steel Blade at rest and walking** (you, with a picture: "instead of pointing forward, this is now the walk/standing still animation of
the arm blade of ukaku"): the arm hangs loose at your side, a little out, and the blade runs down and out from the fist to rest its point just
off the ground at your right; walking, it drags along. The ghouls' arm blades keep their own stance.

**The final kakuja's half mask is back** (you: "revert the mask to the original form we made a few versions ago a small 3d half mask like
this one, I dont like this beak"): the beaked model is gone from the mod; the small half mask over the lower face (a short beak down the
middle, the cheeks wrapped back along the jaw, a pointed wing past each ear, three vents a side) is drawn again, now in the armor's own
colours (you before: "the mask is meant to be the same color as the armor"): the plates' navy, the beak's ridge their pale crest, tinted with
your kagune like the chest.

**Still to come:** any mob cut at a random angle
through its own body; an Ukaku's wings going down with the top half; wider, more violent wing M1s and M2s.
